title: The Story of Fuxi, the Ancestor of Humanity
synopsis: Fuxi is China's first hero and the ancestor of humanity. In Chinese mythology, he is said to have created the dragon, invented the bagua, and taught people how to fish and hunt.

fullText.simplified:
人文始祖伏羲的故事

    很久很久以前，在中国的神话世界里，有一个非常神奇的人，名字叫伏羲。伏羲长着人的脸，但他的身体却像一条大蛇。在古代故事里，伏羲非常聪明和强大。
    首先，伏羲创造了一个新的生物——龙。有一天，伏羲坐在山上，看着天空和大地。他看到了蛇在水里游，鳄鱼在河边休息，鹿在树林里跳，老虎在草丛中走。伏羲想，如果把这些动物的特点结合起来，会怎样呢？他开始用他的神力工作。他把蛇的身体、鳄鱼的头、鹿的角、老虎的眼睛、鱼的鳞片等放在一起，创造了龙。从那以后，中国人常常喜欢说自己是“龙的传人”。
    伏羲不仅创造了龙，他还发明了八卦。他观察天上的云彩、下雨下雪的天气，听雷声、看闪电，还观察地上的风和雾，甚至是飞鸟走兽的动作。通过这些观察，他发现了天地间阴阳变化的规律，他用八种符号来概括天地间的万事万物。这些八卦符号不仅仅用于占卜，更深刻地影响了很多中国的文化。
    最后，伏羲还发明了捕鱼和打猎的网。他看到蜘蛛用网捕食，就想到了一个主意。他做了一个大网，人们就可以用这个网去捕鱼、打猎。这样，捕鱼和打猎就变得更容易了。伏羲还教人们怎么养动物，这些动物后来就变成了家畜。
    伏羲不只是一个神话人物，还是中国文明的一个重要人物。他的智慧和创造力给中国人带来了很多新的东西，改变了人们的生活。
fullText.traditional:
人文始祖伏羲的故事

    很久很久以前，在中國的神話世界裡，有一個非常神奇的人，名字叫伏羲。伏羲長著人的臉，但他的身體卻像一條大蛇。在古代故事裡，伏羲非常聰明和強大。
    首先，伏羲創造了一個新的生物——龍。有一天，伏羲坐在山上，看著天空和大地。他看到了蛇在水裡游，鱷魚在河邊休息，鹿在樹林裡跳，老虎在草叢中走。伏羲想，如果把這些動物的特點結合起來，會怎樣呢？他開始用他的神力工作。他把蛇的身體、鱷魚的頭、鹿的角、老虎的眼睛、魚的鱗片等放在一起，創造了龍。從那以後，中國人常常喜歡說自己是“龍的傳人”。
    伏羲不僅創造了龍，他還發明了八卦。他觀察天上的雲彩、下雨下雪的天氣，聽雷聲、看閃電，還觀察地上的風和霧，甚至是飛鳥走獸的動作。通過這些觀察，他發現了天地間陰陽變化的規律，他用八種符號來概括天地間的萬事萬物。這些八卦符號不僅僅用于占卜，更深刻地影響了很多中國的文化。
    最後，伏羲還發明了捕魚和打獵的網。他看到蜘蛛用網捕食，就想到了一個主意。他做了一個大網，人們就可以用這個網去捕魚、打獵。這樣，捕魚和打獵就變得更容易了。伏羲還教人們怎麼養動物，這些動物後來就變成了家畜。
    伏羲不只是一個神話人物，還是中國文明的一個重要人物。他的智慧和創造力給中國人帶來了很多新的東西，改變了人們的生活。

sentences.simplified: 很久很久以前，在中国的神话世界里，有一个非常神奇的人，名字叫伏羲。
sentences.traditional: 很久很久以前，在中國的神話世界裡，有一個非常神奇的人，名字叫伏羲。
sentences.pinyin: hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ yǐ qián zài zhōng guó de shén huà shì jiè lǐ yǒu yí ge fēi cháng shén qí de rén míng zi jiào fú xī

sentences.simplified: 伏羲长着人的脸，但他的身体却像一条大蛇。
sentences.traditional: 伏羲長著人的臉，但他的身體卻像一條大蛇。
sentences.pinyin: fú xī zhǎng zhe rén de liǎn dàn tā de shēn tǐ què xiàng yì tiáo dà shé
sentences.english: A long, long time ago, in the mythical world of China, there was a very mystical person named Fuxi.

sentences.simplified: 在古代故事里，伏羲非常聪明和强大。
sentences.traditional: 在古代故事裡，伏羲非常聰明和強大。
sentences.pinyin: zài gǔ dài gù shi lǐ fú xī fēi cháng cōng ming hé qiáng dà
sentences.english: Fuxi had the face of a human, but his body was like that of a giant snake.
In ancient stories, Fuxi was very intelligent and powerful.

sentences.simplified: 首先，伏羲创造了一个新的生物——龙。有一天，伏羲坐在山上，看着天空和大地。
sentences.traditional: 首先，伏羲創造了一個新的生物——龍。有一天，伏羲坐在山上，看著天空和大地。
sentences.pinyin: shǒu xiān fú xī chuàng zào le yí ge xīn de shēng wù lóng yǒu yì tiān fú xī zuò zài shān shang kàn zhe tiān kōng hé dà dì

sentences.simplified: 他看到了蛇在水里游，鳄鱼在河边休息，鹿在树林里跳，老虎在草丛中走。
sentences.traditional: 他看到了蛇在水裡游，鱷魚在河邊休息，鹿在樹林裡跳，老虎在草叢中走。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn dào le shé zài shuǐ lǐ yóu è yú zài hé biān xiū xi lù zài shù lín lǐ tiào lǎo hǔ zài cǎo cóng zhōng zǒu
sentences.english: Firstly, Fuxi created a new creature—the dragon. One day, Fuxi sat on a mountain, looking at the sky and the earth.

sentences.simplified: 伏羲想，如果把这些动物的特点结合起来，会怎样呢？
sentences.traditional: 伏羲想，如果把這些動物的特點結合起來，會怎樣呢？
sentences.pinyin: fú xī xiǎng rú guǒ bǎ zhè xiē dòng wù de tè diǎn jié hé qǐ lái huì zěn yàng ne
sentences.english: He saw snakes swimming in the water, alligators resting by the river, deer jumping in the woods, and tigers walking through the underbrush.

sentences.simplified: 他开始用他的神力工作。
sentences.traditional: 他開始用他的神力工作。
sentences.pinyin: tā kāi shǐ yòng tā de shén lì gōng zuò
sentences.english: Fuxi thought, what would happen if the characteristics of these animals were combined?

sentences.simplified: 他把蛇的身体、鳄鱼的头、鹿的角、老虎的眼睛、鱼的鳞片等放在一起，
sentences.traditional: 他把蛇的身體、鱷魚的頭、鹿的角、老虎的眼睛、魚的鱗片等放在一起，
sentences.pinyin: tā bǎ shé de shēn tǐ è yú de tóu lù de jiǎo lǎo hǔ de yǎn jing yú de lín piàn děng fàng zài yì qǐ
sentences.english: He began to work with his divine power.

sentences.simplified: 创造了龙。
sentences.traditional: 創造了龍。
sentences.pinyin: chuàng zào le lóng
sentences.english: He combined the body of a snake, the head of an alligator, the antlers of a deer, the eyes of a tiger, the scales of a fish, and so on, ..

sentences.simplified: 从那以后，中国人常常喜欢说自己是“龙的传人”。
sentences.traditional: 從那以後，中國人常常喜歡說自己是“龍的傳人”。
sentences.pinyin: cóng nà yǐ hòu zhōng guó rén cháng cháng xǐ huan shuō zì jǐ shì lóng de chuán rén
sentences.english: .. to create a dragon.
Since then, Chinese people often like to say that they are “descendants of the dragon”.

sentences.simplified: 伏羲不仅创造了龙，他还发明了八卦。
sentences.traditional: 伏羲不僅創造了龍，他還發明了八卦。
sentences.pinyin: fú xī bù jǐn chuàng zào le lóng tā hái fā míng le bā guà

sentences.simplified: 他观察天上的云彩、下雨下雪的天气，听雷声、看闪电，
sentences.traditional: 他觀察天上的雲彩、下雨下雪的天氣，聽雷聲、看閃電，
sentences.pinyin: tā guān chá tiān shàng de yún cai xià yǔ xià xuě de tiān qì tīng léi shēng kàn shǎn diàn
sentences.english: Not only did Fuxi create the dragon, he also invented the bagua.

sentences.simplified: 还观察地上的风和雾，甚至是飞鸟走兽的动作。
sentences.traditional: 還觀察地上的風和霧，甚至是飛鳥走獸的動作。
sentences.pinyin: hái guān chá dì shang de fēng hé wù shèn zhì shì fēi niǎo zǒu shòu de dòng zuò
sentences.english: He observed the clouds in the sky and the rainy and snowy weather, listened to the thunder, watched the lightning, ..

sentences.simplified: 通过这些观察，他发现了天地间阴阳变化的规律，
sentences.traditional: 通過這些觀察，他發現了天地間陰陽變化的規律，
sentences.pinyin: tōng guò zhè xiē guān chá tā fā xiàn le tiān dì jiān yīn yáng biàn huà de guī lǜ
sentences.english: .. and also observed the wind and fog on the ground, and even the movements of birds and animals.

sentences.simplified: 他用八种符号来概括天地间的万事万物。
sentences.traditional: 他用八種符號來概括天地間的萬事萬物。
sentences.pinyin: tā yòng bā zhǒng fú hào lái gài kuò tiān dì jiān de wàn shì wàn wù
sentences.english: Through these observations, he discovered the laws of yin and yang changes between heaven and earth.

sentences.simplified: 这些八卦符号不仅仅用于占卜，更深刻地影响了很多中国的文化。
sentences.traditional: 這些八卦符號不僅僅用于占卜，更深刻地影響了很多中國的文化。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē bā guà fú hào bù jǐn jǐn yòng yú zhān bǔ gèng shēn kè de yǐng xiǎng le hěn duō zhōng guó de wén huà
sentences.english: He encapsulated the entire universe with eight symbols.
These bagua symbols are not only used for divination but also profoundly influence many aspects of Chinese culture.

sentences.simplified: 最后，伏羲还发明了捕鱼和打猎的网。
sentences.traditional: 最後，伏羲還發明了捕魚和打獵的網。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu fú xī hái fā míng le bǔ yú hé dǎ liè de wǎng

sentences.simplified: 他看到蜘蛛用网捕食，就想到了一个主意。
sentences.traditional: 他看到蜘蛛用網捕食，就想到了一個主意。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn dào zhī zhū yòng wǎng bǔ shí jiù xiǎng dào le yí ge zhǔ yi
sentences.english: Finally, Fuxi also invented nets for fishing and hunting.

sentences.simplified: 他做了一个大网，人们就可以用这个网去捕鱼、打猎。这样，捕鱼和打猎就变得更容易了。
sentences.traditional: 他做了一個大網，人們就可以用這個網去捕魚、打獵。這樣，捕魚和打獵就變得更容易了。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuò le yí ge dà wǎng rén men jiù kě yǐ yòng zhè ge wǎng qù bǔ yú dǎ liè zhè yàng bǔ yú hé dǎ liè jiù biàn de gèng róng yì le
sentences.english: He saw a spider catching its prey with a web and came up with an idea.

sentences.simplified: 伏羲还教人们怎么养动物，这些动物后来就变成了家畜。
sentences.traditional: 伏羲還教人們怎麼養動物，這些動物後來就變成了家畜。
sentences.pinyin: fú xī hái jiāo rén men zěn me yǎng dòng wù zhè xiē dòng wù hòu lái jiù biàn chéng le jiā chù
sentences.english: He made a large net, which people could use to fish and hunt. In this way, fishing and hunting became easier.
Fuxi also taught people how to raise animals, which later became livestock.

sentences.simplified: 伏羲不只是一个神话人物，还是中国文明的一个重要人物。
sentences.traditional: 伏羲不只是一個神話人物，還是中國文明的一個重要人物。
sentences.pinyin: fú xī bù zhǐ shì yí ge shén huà rén wù hái shi zhōng guó wén míng de yí ge zhòng yào rén wù

sentences.simplified: 他的智慧和创造力给中国人带来了很多新的东西，改变了人们的生活。
sentences.traditional: 他的智慧和創造力給中國人帶來了很多新的東西，改變了人們的生活。
sentences.pinyin: tā de zhì huì hé chuàng zào lì gěi zhōng guó rén dài lái le hěn duō xīn de dōng xi gǎi biàn le rén men de shēng huó
sentences.english: Fuxi is not just a mythical figure, but also an important figure in Chinese civilization.

sentence_translations: The Story of Fuxi, the Ancestor of Humanity
A long, long time ago, in the mythical world of China, there was a very mystical person named Fuxi.
Fuxi had the face of a human, but his body was like that of a giant snake.
In ancient stories, Fuxi was very intelligent and powerful.
Firstly, Fuxi created a new creature—the dragon. One day, Fuxi sat on a mountain, looking at the sky and the earth.
He saw snakes swimming in the water, alligators resting by the river, deer jumping in the woods, and tigers walking through the underbrush.
Fuxi thought, what would happen if the characteristics of these animals were combined?
He began to work with his divine power.
He combined the body of a snake, the head of an alligator, the antlers of a deer, the eyes of a tiger, the scales of a fish, and so on, ..
.. to create a dragon.
Since then, Chinese people often like to say that they are “descendants of the dragon”.
Not only did Fuxi create the dragon, he also invented the bagua.
He observed the clouds in the sky and the rainy and snowy weather, listened to the thunder, watched the lightning, ..
.. and also observed the wind and fog on the ground, and even the movements of birds and animals.
Through these observations, he discovered the laws of yin and yang changes between heaven and earth.
He encapsulated the entire universe with eight symbols.
These bagua symbols are not only used for divination but also profoundly influence many aspects of Chinese culture.
Finally, Fuxi also invented nets for fishing and hunting.
He saw a spider catching its prey with a web and came up with an idea.
He made a large net, which people could use to fish and hunt. In this way, fishing and hunting became easier.
Fuxi also taught people how to raise animals, which later became livestock.
Fuxi is not just a mythical figure, but also an important figure in Chinese civilization.
His wisdom and creativity brought many new things to the Chinese people, changing their lives.
